market_summary: USD strength dominates the London/NY overlap session, highlighted by a clean high-volume trend breakdown in XAUUSD below session value and structural support. EURUSD and GBPUSD remain bounded inside their session Value Areas around flat VWAPs, while BTCUSD is heavily oversold near session lows following an earlier volume impulse.

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (3948.58) and POC (3979.43), indicating aggressive value migration lower. CVD is -7.92 with BEARISH label and negative slope (-3.14), agreeing with strong downside pressure during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price broke cleanly below the EMA50 baseline (3955.51) and VWAP (3963.10), expanding outside the lower ATR band (3917.32). The breakout is confirmed by a massive yellow RVOL spike of 2.01, validating acceptance below previous Session Low support at 3900.80 as forming bar prints lower at 3889.29. GEX context is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is inside the session Value Area (VAL 1.10793 to VAH 1.10976) and below POC (1.10928), acting as a fair-value magnet and promoting mean reversion. CVD is NEUTRAL (+1,569) relative to volume during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Structure is tightly tangled with VWAP (1.10862) and EMA50 (1.10885), with candles sitting mid-channel within the ATR bands. RVOL is 1.758 without a fresh spike, and the forming bar is oscillating right around Prev Low support at 1.10824 without directional conviction. GEX context is null.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32593 to VAH 1.32784) and below POC (1.32738). While CVD is BEARISH (-7,351) during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP and price trades below VWAP (1.32657) and EMA50 (1.32678), the market remains contained in the lower half of the ATR channel above Session Low support at 1.32500 and VAL. RVOL is 1.69 (no fresh yellow breakout bar), and price is currently stalling right on Prev Low support at 1.32618. Lacks clean expansion or breakdown confirmation outside value area. GEX context is null.

Price is extended far below VAL (73260.85) and POC (73517.38). CVD is BEARISH with a negative slope, fully aligning with heavy downside momentum in the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Price is well below VWAP (73398.99) and EMA50 (73299.81) and hugging beneath the lower ATR band (72459.49). Although the breakdown from 73000 was confirmed by an RVOL spike earlier, the forming candle is already extended into the 72155.80 Session Low zone without a pullback to lean on, presenting poor immediate risk/reward for chasing shorts. GEX context is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below descending VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance below lower ATR band and test of Session Low
